messages.subject: differences in numbers of hyper/hypo DMCs
parts:
Hello,

I have used methylKit (logistic regression) to determine hyper and hypo DMCs between two groups with ~10 samples for each group: tumour group 1 and tumour group 2. I found hyper and hypo DMCs with both groups as the test and for both groups as the control.

I did the following comparisons: group 1 vs group 2 with group 1 as the test and group 2 vs group 1 with group 2 as the test. I was expecting to see the same number of hyper DMCs when group 1 is the test as hypo DMCs with group 2 as the test and I don’t see that. I get different numbers and I was wondering whether this is correct?

Many thanks
Hannah
